requirements.title: The application shall record today's completion when the "Done today" checkbox is clicked

vision.paraphrase: Goal G2: one click on Done today records the day and persists.

conops.paraphrase: Checking the box is the entire daily ritual — the habit's core interaction.

requirements.title: The application shall remove today's completion when an already-checked "Done today" checkbox is clicked again

vision.paraphrase: The checkbox is a toggle: an accidental check-off can be undone and the streak recomputes.

conops.paraphrase: Check-in state must be correctable in the same session it was made.

requirements.title: The application shall record at most one completion per habit per local calendar day, regardless of repeated clicks or reloads

vision.paraphrase: Completions are a set of unique local dates — one entry per day, by construction.

conops.paraphrase: Repeated interactions with the same day must never inflate the history.

requirements.title: The application shall record completions as local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in the user's timezone, not UTC dates

vision.paraphrase: Completion identifiers are local dates in YYYY-MM-DD form.

conops.paraphrase: Streak semantics are local-day based (ConOps §8); UTC day boundaries would misalign check-ins.
